campuses.title: de Havilland Campus
campuses.text: Бизнес-школа, юриспруденция, гуманитарные. HIC на этом кампусе.

paragraphs: University of Hertfordshire (Herts) is a public university in Hatfield, just north of London (25 minutes by train from King's Cross). Founded in 1992 from the Hatfield Polytechnic, Herts is best known for aerospace engineering (former de Havilland aircraft factory site), business, computer science, and pharmacy. The de Havilland Campus has Europe's largest student bar.

International students enter via Hertfordshire International College (HIC) — Navitas's pathway college on the Hertfordshire de Havilland Campus. Foundation, First-Year-Degree, and Pre-Master programs lead into a Herts Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: University of Hertfordshire (Herts) — государственный университет в Hatfield, к северу от Лондона (25 минут на поезде от King's Cross). Основан в 1992 из Hatfield Polytechnic. Известен аэрокосмической инженерией (бывший завод de Havilland aircraft), бизнесом, computer science, фармацией. На de Havilland Campus — самый большой студенческий бар в Европе.

Международные студенты заходят через Hertfordshire International College (HIC) — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе Hertfordshire de Havilland. Foundation, First-Year-Degree и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Herts.
